canonical_project: SENUM Datacenter National de Diamniadio (national government data center)
notes: SENUM official page lists Diamniadio among three operational state datacenters (Orana, Technopole, Diamniadio). Inaugurated 22 June 2021 by President Macky Sall at the Diamniadio Digital Technology Park; press cites 500-1,000 sqm technical/hosting space and ~1.4 MW (B-grade). AidData project 73114 describes a Tier 3 state data center (~1,000 TB) built with Chinese-loan finance and Huawei support. Capacity field is a B-grade press figure, not an official SENUM technical sheet.
